track_b_xcu_entry_delta.scaleout_note: v1 deliberately fences max_logical_cells at the current 10-cell baseline; SCALEOUT requires a later explicitly versioned and measured budget policy rather than silently widening authority.

hypothesis: A two-level identity contract, immutable semantic event_sha256 plus admission-specific ingress_id, prevents causal aliasing across routing-equivalent events while allowing policy/budget re-admission to remain auditable without making admission policy part of observed-event identity.
counterhypothesis: One ingress digest over the complete packet is sufficient; separate event identity adds complexity without improving replay, routing or audit safety.
cheapest_discriminators: same exact input replay must produce identical event_sha256 and ingress_id
same observed event with only admission budget changed must keep event_sha256 but change ingress_id
different observed payloads that could later select the same route class must not share event_sha256 or ingress_id

unusual_experiment.design: Hold causal/generation/source/provenance/timestamps/admission envelope constant; change only semantically material payload magnitude while preserving the likely downstream route class. Falsifier: equal event_sha256 or ingress_id.
